analysis.summary: Android Termux is displaying a shell-script test related to detecting payment approval. A Finnish confirmation dialog reports that approval was not recognized, while the background script logs approval and payment states.
analysis.visual_type: Android Termux terminal with modal confirmation dialog and on-screen Finnish keyboard
technical_clues: Shell script conditional logic using printf and grep
Logging with date and timestamp formatting
Test completion marker visible as TEST END
Interactive YES and NO dialog buttons
Finnish Android user interface and keyboard
analysis.possible_software_task: Debug or improve a Termux shell-script workflow that detects payment approval responses, classifies them as approved, rejected, or unknown, records results to a log, and presents a confirmation dialog.
